introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce: Stand or sit on the floor. Raise your shoulders up towards your ears as far as you can, then drop them. Repeat the exercise.
name: SHOULDER SHRUGS

tips.text: Raise your shoulders up as high as you can.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale as you raise your shoulders, and inhale as you drop them.
This exercise can loosen up your neck and upper back.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the right. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your left arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the left. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your right arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet together, and grab your toes.\n\nOpen your knees to the sides, and press your knees down as much as possible.
name: SEATED BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Press your knees down as much as possible.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and gently press your knees down.

Exhale, hinge forward from your hips, reaching your hands toward the floor. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lift and extend through your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
name: EASY BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

introduce: Sit with your right leg extended to the right and your left leg bent. Then reach your left arm overhead, and bend your upper body to the right. \n\nHold this position.
name: EASY HALF SPLITS SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
You should feel the deep stretch in your hamstring and underneath your armpit.
This position stretches your outer thighs and hamstring.

introduce: Sit with your left leg extended to the left and your right leg bent. Then reach your right arm overhead, and bend your upper body to the left. \n\nHold this position.
name: EASY HALF SPLITS SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
You should feel the deep stretch in your hamstring and underneath your armpit.
This position stretches your outer thighs and hamstring.

introduce: Sit on the ground with your legs extended out to the sides and your toes towards the ceiling. \n\nThen turn your upper body to the right, and try to lean forward. Go back to center, and repeat on the other side.
name: EASY WIDE SEATED DYNAMIC FOLD

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Exhale when you fold forward, and inhale when you go back.
You should feel the deep stretch in your hamstrings and inner thighs.
This position helps open up your hips.
This position can stretch your hamstrings and lower back.

introduce: Sit upright with your legs extended out to the sides. \n\nTry to fold your upper body forward slowly. You can put your hands in front of you for support and slightly bend your knees. Hold this position.
name: EASY SPLITS FORWARD FOLD

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe deeply.
Keep your core tight.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.

introduce:
Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position. Open your knees and lower your pelvis until you feel a mild stretch. Turn your toes outward to the sides, so the big toe edge of your feet is on the floor. 

Exhale as you lower your chest towards the floor. Inhale as you slowly move your body forward. Then exhale, ease back. 

Gently rock your hips forward and back. Inhale to lengthen your spine and create space in your body, and exhale to relax deeper into the stretch.
name: DYNAMIC FROG POSE

tips.text: Inhale to lengthen your spine and exhale to deepen the stretch in your hips and groin.
Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your tailbone tucked down.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, groin and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back and inhale. Exhale to draw your knees toward your chest, separate the knees, and raise the feet so the soles of the feet are toward the ceiling.

Inhale, grab the inside of your feet. Exhale, gently sink the shoulders and tailbone toward the floor.

Hold the position. Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to soften your hips and lower back into the mat.
name: HAPPY BABY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on the mat.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your hips and lower back.
Keep your head on the mat to avoid neck strain.
This exercise can help relieve your lower back pain.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, hamstrings, groin, and spine.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and feet together. Place your arms close to your body and palms facing down.

Exhale, press your elbows and forearms into the floor to lift your head and upper back off the floor. Lower your head backward and rest the crown of your head on the mat.

Hold this position. Inhale to expand your chest, exhale to soften your chest and shoulders.
name: FISH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Too much pressure on your head or neck? You can put a little more weight on your arms.
This exercise helps ease tensions in your spine and neck.
This exercise opens your chest and strengthens your back and shoulders.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to soften your chest and shoulders.

introduce:
Lie face up on the mat. Firm your back into the floor and press your arms into the floor.

Inhale, lift your legs over your head. Exhale, slowly lower your legs over your head and lower your toes toward the floor. Clasp your hands, ground your shoulders. Keep your hips above your shoulders. 

Hold this position. Lengthen your spine on each inhale, and soften deeper into the stretch on each exhale.
name: PLOUGH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your hips above your shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to soften into the stretch.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and spine.
